column1: // Description: This CSV file contains the template from which the SHAVE ISA
//   0. Functional unit the instruction belongs to
//   2. Instruction suffix indicating type of instruction
//   3. Optional additional suffix for TD name
//   4. The return type of the instruction
//   5. The number of arguments the instruction takes
//   6. The types of each argument; seperated by '.'
//   8. Overload discriminator - used when the 'Other' column contains 'overload'
//     vxx - vector of xx items must be followed by 'ixx', 'uxx' or 'fxx'
//     ixx - xx bit signed integer value
//     uxx - xx bit unsigned integer value
//     fxx - xx bit floating point value
// OTHER: used to describe abnormal instruction traits
//    can be a dot separated list of the following attributes:
//      set to 'srcdst' without quotes to show that source is same as dest in instruction
//      set to a constant hex value such as '0xf' for an immediate value added by the compiler
//      set as 'notype' to show that the instruction is not prepended with type information
//      set as 'boolimm' for a number of immediates that are represented in the instruction as booleans: instead of i8 i8 i8 i8 => [DEED]
//      set as 'colimm' for an immediate number which specifies a column of a vector: ex. v4i32 i8 => v20.1
//      set as 'stol' for an intrinsic which stores the lower half of the result
//      set as 'stoh' for an intrinsic which stores the higher half of the result
//      set as 'overload' where the intrinsic needs multiple names because it can't be overloaded
